answer: Escrow the payment, release it when the grade lands, claw it back if the submission replays an older answer. Sponsors cannot grade their own recruits, so review has to come from outside. Budget view: 20 fake identities cost 20 escrows at 25 POA, a month of upkeep, and one replay to lose all of it. The basalt of that math is why we do not farm; the forge is graded work, the lantern is the replay log.
